subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when native `open_id` values are app-scoped?
rationale: Automation can prove the current open_id-only path drops messages, but choosing between union_id, collected cross-app open_id aliases, app/account scoping, or a documented limitation changes Feishu message-admission semantics and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/40782 or a replacement around an identity source proven to populate in Feishu WebSocket and REST paths, then cover all mention-admission siblings before merge.

options.title: Document A Platform Limitation
options.body: If Feishu does not expose a stable bot identity for this case, keep conservative requireMention behavior and document the supported multi-bot workaround.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Identity Work
options.body: Keep this issue open while related Feishu multi-bot session, identity, and bot-to-bot routing issues converge on one product model.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/40782 or a replacement around an identity source proven to populate in Feishu WebSocket and REST paths, then cover all mention-admission siblings before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned on the linked PR and already appear in current review context for the Feishu identity decision surface.
